series.name: The Traka World Series
series.tagline: Klassmark's seven-round elite gravel series, built around The Traka in Girona.
series.description: The Traka World Series is Klassmark's elite gravel championship from 2027, replacing the Gravel Earth Series. Seven rounds run from February in Catalonia to an October finale in Spain, with stops in Monegros, Girona, Iowa and Bouillon in the Belgian Ardennes, plus a new Traka-format race outside Europe. Every round is a Klassmark race or carries its By The Traka label, which is the change that matters: Gravel Earth licensed its name to independent organizers, and Klassmark now keeps full control of its calendar. Women and men race for separate overall titles, and every round is covered live.
series.history: Klassmark ran Gravel Earth as a license system around The Traka from 2023. It grew to more than 20 events in 13 countries in 2025, was cut to twelve for 2026, and ended after that season. Klassmark announced The Traka World Series on November 5, 2026. Several Gravel Earth races are not on the 2027 calendar, including The Hills, Ranxo, Oregon Trail, Lost and Found, Migration Gravel Race, Megre and Cuckoo Iceland. The Rift in Iceland runs independently on July 23-24, 2027.
series.format_overview: Two rounds use the full Traka format of 300, 200 and 100 km: The Traka in Girona, where the 300 is the PRO race, and a new event outside Europe in the first half of April. The other five carry the By The Traka label, introduced in 2026, and set their own distances. Each round pays EUR 8,000 and the final standings pay EUR 20,000, EUR 76,000 in all, split equally between women and men.
